purpose: Exploratory subject-disjoint, single-view, repetition-level multilabel error recognition; no clinical validation
fold_rule: test=subjects[i], validation=subjects[(i+1)%5], train=other three; all views and exercises of each person stay together
labels: Five exercise-specific errors, union of primary and additional labels. Correct repetitions have all-zero targets.
input: Single-camera MediaPipe 3d world landmarks; no RGB, orientation metadata or participant identity supplied to the model

preprocessing.translation: subtract hip midpoint at every frame
preprocessing.scale: divide by per-repetition median shoulder-midpoint to hip-midpoint Euclidean distance
preprocessing.resampling: linear xyz interpolation to 96 frames; visibility uses minimum of adjacent source frames
preprocessing.missing: reject nonfinite or full-zero frames rather than silently impute in this first audited dataset
preprocessing.standardization: per-feature mean/std fitted on current training subjects only

tcn.loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss, negative/positive class weights computed only from training data

threshold_selection: per-error F1 on validation person only, grid 0.15 to 0.85 step 0.05; ties closest to 0.5
primary_metrics: macro F1 over five error labels
counting: Primary predictions are single-view observations; report physical repetition and subject counts separately. No independent-sample CI over camera observations.

reliability.score: minimum over labels of threshold-normalized absolute score distance; heuristic, not calibrated probability
reliability.selection: highest validation coverage with coverage>=0.5 and exact-label-set accuracy>=0.8; if none qualifies, mark unsupported and report unfiltered predictions
reliability.report: Always report unconditional metrics, retained coverage, retained metrics, and policy qualification; no test-based threshold adjustment

stress_test.name: synthetic_right_arm_noise
stress_test.scope: Evaluation only, same trained models and validation thresholds; diagnostic synthetic noise, not evidence of real occlusion robustness

limitations: one seed in this first suite
estimated 3d pose rather than motion capture
no automatic action selection or repetition detection
